source: z_local in metres = height of each LOLA surface point above the site's local tangent plane, z = U.(P - O) in Moon-centred Cartesian coordinates with O = (1737.4 km + 5039.6 m) U at the site (the site's terrain height, as in public/horizons observerHeightM - 2 m), so the curvature drop (about 2.07 km at the corners) is included; heightMinM/heightMaxM are the min/max of z_local. Each sample is the surface point whose exact east/north offsets equal its grid (x, y). Heights, bilinear, share of samples: LOLA LDEM_80S_80M (PDS) 100%. Both grids are area-averaged to 480 m first (6 x 6 and 2 x 2 pixels), close to the 468.75 m spacing; features smaller than that are smoothed out. No sample needed filling: all lie inside the grids' coverage. Uint16 little-endian, row-major, z = heightMinM + v * (heightMaxM - heightMinM) / 65535.
grid: local ENU tangent plane at the site; x = east, y = north; row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge
